description: An MCP server for live-event discovery and price watching. v0.1 is phase F0: read-only discovery over a local stub feed shaped like Ticketmaster Discovery and SeatGeek Platform responses, plus a Price Watcher evaluated against a shipped four-snapshot price series. The normalized model preserves section, row, and seat semantics; face value and service/facility/processing fees remain separate fields, and watcher ceilings compare only the all-in per-ticket price. A successor watch may only tighten (lower ceiling, narrower sections, no later expiry); loosening is rejected by name. Alerts and evaluations append hash-chained receipts, and evaluations store first-party price-history points with per-source provenance. There are no purchase, checkout, transfer, or resale tools.
